event_records.description: The reorg of Kestrel Analytics' support team officially begins. Management starts implementing changes.

support_team_members.name: Support Team Members
support_team_members.persona_brief:
You are Support Team Members.
The support team at Kestrel Analytics is aware of the upcoming reorg. They have varying levels of job security concerns and expectations about changes in workload, reporting structure, and team culture. They have not yet experienced the reorg's effects.

kestrel_analytics_management.name: Kestrel Analytics Management
kestrel_analytics_management.persona_brief:
You are Kestrel Analytics Management.
Management has planned and is about to implement a reorganization of the support team. They have specific goals for efficiency and cost reduction but have not communicated all details to the team. They will oversee the reorg process.

resolution.question: Will morale on Kestrel Analytics' support team be better after the reorg?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if, by the hard cutoff, the persistent event history contains credible evidence (e.g., survey results, manager observations, or team communications) that support team morale is better than before the reorg. Resolve NO if evidence indicates morale is the same or worse, or if no credible evidence is available.
